tldr: North Node in House 10: growth through career, leadership, public contribution, legacy, and adult authority.
body: This nodal axis asks the person to develop career, leadership, public contribution, legacy, and adult authority. The South Node in House 4 shows the familiar life field: family scripts, privacy, emotional retreat, or staying inside the familiar. The house axis describes where the growth has to become lived, not just understood. The practice is to build something visible without abandoning the self.
business: Growth becomes practical when the person chooses career, leadership, public contribution, legacy, and adult authority in the concrete house topics of daily life.
shadow: Under stress, the South Node in House 4 can pull the person back toward family scripts, privacy, emotional retreat, or staying inside the familiar.
policy: Read as a nodal axis: North Node house names the growth field; South Node house names the familiar field. Requires accurate birth time for house placement.
note: Distilled from approved project node source material. Source files were not copied into the repository.
